sara (release-ops): Quick alert: embeddings in eu1 started returning intermittent 503s ~03:02 UTC. Impacting web search and onboarding flows. Requesting a hotfix window and expedited approval (aiming for a 03:30 UTC canary).
releasebot: Hotfix ticket created by @sara: service=embeddings env=prod region=eu1 proposed_image=embed-service:v2025.12.02-hotfix. Canary plan attached. Auto-rollback rules: >0.4% 503 delta OR p95 latency +1.2s above baseline.
jorge (sre): I can back the fast-track if eng + platform sign off. Have we verified the root cause?
sara (release-ops): Root cause suspected: race in kvcache eviction when under burst. Olivia validated a patch in staging. Patch PR: https://gh/internal/embeds/PR/4339. Ana, can you confirm platform constraints for pinning?
